title: Resonance is one species
statement:
Which description correctly interprets the two main ozone contributors?

[_]{a}

choices: One resonance hybrid has two equivalent bonds.
Ozone is a mixture of two substances.
A terminal O switches to the center.
One real bond is permanently single and the other double.
explanations: The contributors are representations of one species.
The Lewis pictures are not separately existing isomers.
That would make the terminal bonds inequivalent.

hints: Both have the same atom connectivity.
The two O–O bonds in ozone are equivalent.
The drawings describe a single delocalized electronic structure.
solution: Both have the same atom connectivity. The two O–O bonds in ozone are equivalent. The drawings describe a single delocalized electronic structure. The contributors are representations of one species.
